name: Twine
long_description:
Twine helps service businesses turn more leads into revenue by bringing their entire sales process into one workspace.

We connect calls, texts, website inquiries, Google, Yelp, and other lead sources into one shared inbox where inside sales teams, field reps, and AI agents work together to qualify leads, book jobs, and follow up with customers.

Twine also connects customer conversations, sales activity, marketing attribution, and revenue data so businesses can understand what's working, where opportunities are being lost, and what to do next.

We're starting with pest control, building alongside some of the industry's leading operators to create the sales infrastructure for the next generation of service businesses.
one_liner: The AI sales workspace for service businesses.
